purpose: Development-only correctness check of cached exact greedy phase selection.
development_rule: Cache fixed-angle trigonometric factors and batch masks; preserve original greedy policy and magnitude fallback. Recompute near ties with the original evaluator. No fitted hyperparameters or changed angles.
limitations: Timings during an independently running validation are diagnostic only and not the controlled performance result.
This is an implementation acceleration, not an algorithmic novelty claim.
